## Player like Spotify, faster start, cover editor
- **Artist next to the song:** when the music plays on headphones or a Bluetooth device, the mini player shows "Song • Artist" on one line and the device below, like Spotify
- **Queue and lyrics as a sheet:** a grip on top. Pull it up and it fills the screen, pull it down and it gets small again. While small it does not scroll; trying to scroll makes it big
- **"Now playing" in the middle** of the big player's top bar
- **Status bar in the page colour (Android):** the strip at the very top takes the colour of the big player or of the album or artist header, nothing moves
- **Albums like playlists:** every song shows its cover with the moving equalizer on the one that plays. **Save albums** of artists to your library with one tap
- **Equalizer on the cover always shows** on phones (it used to vanish after tapping a song)
- **Pin playlists to Home** from their … menu, they come right after Liked songs
- **Rename this device** in Settings → Devices; your other devices and the device picker show that name
- **"Open on Spotify" keeps the player:** the Spotify app opens and Streyn stays as it was when you come back
- **Faster start:** a loading animation, the Android app opens the last working address at once and checks home and on-the-go addresses at the same time, and the server sends the app packed (about a third of the size) and only when it changed
- **Monthly listeners from Spotify** for every artist, as the full number like Spotify shows it, also on artist pages of your own files
- **Mini player visualizer** is off until you choose it; the setup now asks
- **New cover editor** like Spotify's "Create cover": background colours and gradients, a photo (upload or a song cover of the playlist) to move and zoom, the name in six text styles with position, size, colour and shadow, and effects (duotone, black & white, grain, vignette, soft, light)

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new installer
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates
